line: - **Appearance (as of ch 673):** Baeksang has handsome, refined features, a well-proportioned physique, and eyes that burn with flame-like intensity. He wears all-white clothing and ornaments from head to toe, including snow-white robes with flowing sleeves and garments made of white fox fur.
